description:
MARKERS CLOSE AND STAY ATTACHED. Three same-length RIP-relative re-aims. No pool cell is ever written; each edit changes one instruction's disp32 so it loads a different EXISTING cell. WHO IT AFFECTS: COM-CONTROLLED PLAYERS ONLY - CPU opponents AND your own AI team-mates. Your stick-controlled player never runs ActionMark and never asks the AI gait chooser where to go.

EDIT 1 - defensive sprint threshold 19.0 -> 15.0, minus 0.1 x attribute(0x17). At 0x143da9553 the AI gait chooser loads 19.0 and subtracts 0.1 * an ability value fetched through the ability getters at 0x143da942d/0x143da943a (confirmed an integer attribute, not a distance: 0x143da9454 does 'movd xmm6, eax; cvtdq2ps'). Then 0x143da95a3 'comiss xmm9, xmm7; jbe 0x143da96c8' SKIPS the whole sprint block when distance <= threshold, so a lower threshold is strictly MORE sprinting. Direction: b-CERTAIN. The relation is INVERTED from what you might expect - threshold = C - 0.1*attr means a HIGHER-rated player gets a SHORTER sprint runway (stock: attr 99 -> 9.1 m, attr 40 -> 15.0 m; patched: attr 99 -> 5.1 m, attr 40 -> 11.0 m). State the change as what it robustly is: a UNIFORM -4.0 m for every player, i.e. everyone breaks into a sprint 4 m later and therefore arrives at a higher speed. It cannot go negative (worst case 15.0 - 0.1*99 = 5.1 m on the 40-99 scale).
  c-INFERRED, and this was overstated in the first draft: the load is NOT unconditional. 0x143da9540 does 'cmp byte ptr [r14+0x28d], 0' and 0x143da9551 'jne 0x143da95a3' SKIPS the patched instruction entirely when that byte is non-zero, leaving xmm7 as previously loaded. So this edit is one ARM of a branch, and that the zero arm is the DEFENCE arm is asserted, not shown - the same byte is also tested at 0x143da9401. There is also a further conditional addend at 0x143da9597 (xmm7 += xmm8*xmm2 when 36.0 > [rcx+rdx+0x1844]) that the simple formula omits. Failure mode to add to your list: NOTHING CHANGES AT ALL (byte rarely zero), or attacking players close faster (byte==0 is the attack arm).

EDIT 2 - mark-priority radius around the ball 18.0 -> 25.0 m. At 0x1441a29f9 'addss xmm6, [18.0]', then 0x1441a2a05 squares it and 0x1441a2a09 'comiss xmm6, xmm4' (xmm4 = squared distance to the ball) with 0x1441a2a0c promoting the rank. A larger radius makes the comparison true for strictly more defenders: b-CERTAIN.
  CORRECTION to the first draft's instruction text, which said 'cmova ebx, 2'. The actual bytes at 0x1441a2a0c are 0F 47 DD = 'cmova ebx, ebp'. The substance nevertheless survives, and this was checked rather than assumed: ebp is set by 'mov ebp, 2' at 0x1441a2996, and a full register-write scan of 0x1441a2996-0x1441a2a10 finds no other write to ebp/rbp/bpl, and no branch anywhere in 0x1441a2000-0x1441a3000 targets that range from outside it. So the rank written really is the constant 2. b-CERTAIN.
  c-INFERRED and unchanged as the weak link: that rank 2 BEATS rank 3, i.e. that promoting more defenders produces MORE man-marking rather than less. Taken from the two cmovl minima at 0x1441a2887 and 0x1441a2a56. If it is backwards you will see FEWER markers, which is obvious within a minute.

EDIT 3 - man-ward steering cap 45 -> 90 degrees. At 0x1441a2475 'minss xmm8, [45.0]', feeding the third argument of the rotate-toward helper 0x144345690 at 0x1441a26f6, so a larger cap strictly allows more man-ward steering: b-CERTAIN. Units are degrees: the replacement cell 0x145b52b90 sits inside a 90.0 / 180.0 / 270.0 run. Do NOT also re-aim the 0.5 loaded at 0x1441a23eb - that cell is reused for the midpoint at 0x1441a2408.

EVIDENCE LEVEL OVERALL: b-DISASSEMBLY, NOT EMULATED. ActionMark needs a fully built team-AI graph, which is more state than a Unicorn harness can stub honestly. All three sites verified byte-identical in PRISTINE and the INSTALLED image, disp32 recomputed by hand as target_cell - address_of_next_instruction, and the patched bytes re-decoded through capstone to confirm they land on cells holding exactly 15.0, 25.0 and 90.0. All three replacement cells are 4-byte-aligned read-only pool constants in .tls$ with zero writers.

WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN ONE MATCH: defenders sprinting the last few metres onto a receiver rather than closing at a jog; the second bank stepping onto men when the ball comes into your half; a full-back going WITH a winger's run instead of drifting between him and the touchline. FAILURE MODES: (a) edit 1 lives in a gait chooser with several callers, so it speeds up ALL COM defensive movement, not only marking - expect more stamina burned and watch for tired legs in the last twenty minutes; (b) edit 3's wide cap can let a defender turn his back on the ball chasing a decoy run; (c) jitter or oscillation around the marked man means the approach is now too fast to settle; (d) nothing changes at all - see edit 1's gate.

NO STRONGER VERSION IS OFFERED. The first draft suggested dropping edit 1 to 12.0; that gives a 99-rated player a 2.1 m runway, and combined with edit 3's 90-degree steering cap it makes failure mode (c) near-certain. Do not do it while edit 3 is applied.

NOT INCLUDED, DELIBERATELY: the arrival caps at 0x1441a58ba / 0x1441a58d5, which are the existing UNAPPLIED spec tools/data/patches/phys-marking-tight.json, and the approach gait bands at 0x1441a43b6 / 0x1441a43cc, which are the separate UNAPPLIED phys-marking-bands-UNVERIFIED-AB.json. A byte-level audit of every spec in tools/data/patches confirms this pack shares no byte with either of them, with any other spec, or with the 121 bytes already applied to your exe. Test phys-marking-tight.json FIRST (it is the more visible half), then this one. Also not included: the man-ward steering fade floor at 0x1441a2642 / 0x1441a2675, which has a paired-constant foot-gun - changing the floor without the slope makes the bias go NEGATIVE and steers markers AWAY from their man.

REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/marking-tight.json

patches.name: defensive sprint distance 19.0 -> 15.0 (minus 0.1 x attribute)
patches.note: movss xmm7, [0x1462c0000 = 19.0] re-aimed to [0x145c0b000 = 15.0]. disp32 recomputed as 0x145c0b000 - 0x143da955b = 0x1e61aa5. Site byte-identical in PRISTINE and installed. GATED: 0x143da9551 'jne 0x143da95a3' skips this instruction when byte [r14+0x28d] is non-zero, so the edit is inert on that arm - that the zero arm is the defence arm is c-inferred. Uniform -4.0 m for every player.

patches.name: mark-priority radius around the ball 18 m -> 25 m
patches.note: addss xmm6, [0x1462aa550 = 18.0] re-aimed to [0x145da7de0 = 25.0]. disp32 = 0x145da7de0 - 0x1441a2a01 = 0x1c053df. ActionMark::vf22 only. The consumer is 'cmova ebx, ebp' at 0x1441a2a0c (NOT an immediate), with ebp proven to be the constant 2 from 'mov ebp, 2' at 0x1441a2996 and no intervening write. The remaining c-inferred element is that rank 2 beats rank 3.

patches.name: man-ward steering cap 45 deg -> 90 deg
patches.note: minss xmm8, [0x145b1d910 = 45.0] re-aimed to [0x145b52b90 = 90.0]. 9-byte instruction, disp32 is the last 4 bytes: 0x145b52b90 - 0x1441a247e = 0x19b0712. ActionMark::vf20 only. Degrees confirmed by the 90/180/270 run around the target cell.
